cues.fragment: The wind flicks your hair back / When it's down
cues.title: Intimate Chest Entry & Dynamic Peak
cues.text: Strongest vocal presence of the track (85% strength on 'When it's down'): keep the delivery close-mic and velvety across 9 semitones (G3–E4) with steady 85% sustain.

cues.fragment: As I lay on the ground / The wind slides your hand
cues.title: 12-Semitone Sweep & Legato Flow
cues.text: Hold 'As I lay on the ground' with 91% sustain and warm 34% vibrato, then glide smoothly across a 12-semitone arc through 'The wind slides your hand'.

cues.fragment: Up your gown / As I lay with no sound
cues.title: Agile Low-Register Phrasing
cues.text: Second-highest agility passage in the song: articulate the quick vocal turns cleanly on 'As I lay with no sound' while keeping a warm, resonant chest tone (84% strength).

cues.fragment: My hands are tied / With you by my side
cues.title: Widest 14-Semitone Leap & B4 Sustain
cues.text: Widest pitch span in the measured passages (14.4 semitones) jumping up to B4 on 'With you by my side'; maintain 90% sustain and float into head mix without throat tension.

cues.fragment: Late at night with no one around / You give me joy, make me your toy
cues.title: Airy Head-Voice Hook (B4–C5)
cues.text: Lean into the dreamy head-voice color (up to 58% head-voice dominance near C5) on 'You give me joy, make me your toy', keeping agile turns crisp and weightless.

cues.fragment: Go back and forth 'til I'm out
cues.title: Title Hook & Vibrato Release
cues.text: Phrase 'Go back and forth 'til I'm out' with a resonant B4 peak and blossoming vibrato (44%) before tapering gently into the atmospheric vocal interlude.

cues.fragment: The way you look at me with those naked eyes / Strips the soul of my life
cues.title: Rich Vibrato & Sustained Chest Tone
cues.text: Re-enter after the flute interlude with commanding presence (84% strength), letting warm 37% vibrato and 89% sustain carry 'those naked eyes' and 'Strips the soul of my life'.

cues.fragment: The way you force your way / On my thigh
cues.title: Peak Agility Run & G4 Climb
cues.text: Highest agility line in the song: navigate the rapid melodic turns cleanly on 'The way you force your way' before opening into a resonant G4 belt on 'On my thigh'.

cues.fragment: Oh babe, I lose my mind / I'm missing you, the things that we do, under the moon
cues.title: Head-Voice Surge & Peak Vibrato (38%)
cues.text: Richest vibrato passage (38%) with intense head-voice dominance (up to 94% on 'I'm missing you'): span 12 semitones up to C5 with tall vowels and steady breath support.

cues.fragment: And babe, I've been wanting you to (ooh)
cues.title: C#5 Emotional Belt & Long Melisma
cues.text: Drive into a passionate C#5 peak (92% vocal strength) and spin the long descending melisma on steady rib expansion so the tone stays connected through the 11-second phrase.

cues.fragment: I've been wanting you to (ooh, ooh)
cues.title: Soaring E5–G5 Falsetto Climax
cues.text: Release all jaw and neck tension to float the song's highest falsetto wails (E5 up to G5), letting the voice bloom into the reverb before fading softly into the outro.
